Creator: The Church of the Brethren (Germantown and Conestoga congregations); compiler not named on the title page
Publisher: Germantown, Pa.: Christoph Saur
Publication Date: 1744
Rights: Public Domain (published 1744, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Language: deu
Source: Internet Archive item kleinedavidische00chur (https://archive.org/details/kleinedavidische00chur), the item's own kleinedavidische00chur_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: Princeton Theological Seminary Library; host metadata date: 1744. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-16. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 7d3b293ebf07e0c3163ad0ab44397a1f7ec0c55706ab055b91c40440577100f9.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. The Princeton Theological Seminary bookplate and some mirrored-text noise open the file and are left in place. Two-column hymn pages are sometimes interleaved line by line in this OCR.
Content note: The Brethren's own standard hymnal for a century, as distinct from the Ephrata hymnals; also used by Pennsylvania Mennonites. No PD English translation exists.
